evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensures high quality delivery of software consulting services and overall client satisfaction
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Quality/client-satisfaction language balances against sales-pipeline-driving and services-delivery-speed framing, giving mixed weight to both.
evidence.domain_risk: Overall knowledge of MHE technologies and warehouse systems or similar domains is preferred
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: This is a customer-facing analytics consulting role for warehouse/logistics/supply-chain solutions without financial-reporting, audit, or regulatory language, placing this at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The JD describes an established 'analytics services program' and 'Software Center of Excellence' already operating with multiple named tools and customer engagements, indicating a growing but already-functioning practice.
evidence.jd_authorship: Proficient experience in Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and/or Google BigQuerry
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The bullets are largely generic consulting-role boilerplate ('proven success in Client Management, Project Management, and Services Delivery', 'displays depth of knowledge to customers') with tool names listed but little concrete day-to-day technical scope, characteristic of recruiter-style postings.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Supports the sales organization and drive pipeline generation of analytics consulting services
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is explicitly customer-facing and sales-pipeline-oriented (client engagements, sales-phase presentations, pipeline generation), a commercial orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: you will own end-to-end implementation of analytics engagements with Dematic customers, while driving the services pipeline
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines end-to-end engagement ownership and driving the services pipeline (strategic-leaning) with responding to defined customer requirements and following business process analysis (execution), making this mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tooling or AI-adjacent responsibility is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Absent — no testing, data quality, or data contract language appears anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The JD focuses on client-facing analytics consulting and BI tool delivery rather than any data testing or quality framework.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in sales, delivery, and client-satisfaction terms with no risk, compliance, or reliability register present.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: be a key voice internally for the further development of the analytics services program
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both develops/extends an existing analytics services program (fix/scale) and concepts/designs new customer solutions from scratch (greenfield) roughly evenly, making this mixed.
